subject: Leadership follow-up: impact, risks, procurement checkpoints
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@novacare.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@novacare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership follow-up: impact, risks, procurement checkpoints

Hi Sophie / Daniel —

Thanks again for taking time with us today. Short recap from my side so the leadership team has a single source of truth and clear next steps. I focused this note on outcomes, immediate risks we surfaced, and the procurement path we discussed.

Key pains (what you described)
- Unpredictable inference costs at scale (monthly variance impacting forecast).
- Latency spikes during peak hours, leading to timeouts in production (noted in the support dashboard).
- Strict data residency and audit log requirements from compliance for PII-containing prompts.

Stated goals (leadership metrics)
- Stabilize 95th percentile latency to <200ms at ~1k QPS for interactive features.
- Reduce per-token inference cost by ~30–35% through batching/quantization for baseline flows.
- Provide audit logs and replay capability for any search/LLM call within 30 days.

Top risks we should manage now
1) Security/compliance evidence (SOC2 + access to audit logs) — critical for procurement sign-off.
2) Procurement timeline & single-vendor constraints — budget cycle hits in ~6 weeks.
3) Pilot scope creep — starting narrow will help surface value quickly.

Proposed procurement/checkpoint path (what we agreed)
- Week 0–2: Internal security questionnaire and evidence exchange (you flagged SOC2 docs + audit sample). Owner: Naomi / Rishi.
- Week 2–4: Technical pilot (30–45 days, sandbox data if needed) with Solutions Eng and one LOB owner. Owner: Marissa.
- Week 4–6: Commercial review + PO submission (vendor terms, SOW). Owner: Sophie procurement + Redwood finance.
- Post-pilot: Decision node (roll to Dedicated capacity vs continue hosted).

Open asks / next steps (owners & dates)
- Naomi: Share redwood-sponsor-summary.xlsx and redwood-risk-checklist.pdf (attached) — requested today.
- Sophie: Share procurement contact and confirm budget cadence by 9/10.
- Rishi: Book 30-min technical deep-dive with SE and Security (options below).
- Marissa: Draft pilot success criteria doc and link to shared drive.

Proposed slots for the technical deep-dive (30 minutes)
- Thu 9/9 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu 9/9 14:00–14:30 PT
- Fri 9/10 09:00–09:30 PT

Attachments: redwood-sponsor-summary.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-risk-checklist.pdf (security checklist).

If any of the owners above should be swapped, call it out and I’ll update. Appreciate the clear framing today — we’ll aim to keep the pilot tight and evidence-first so procurement can move fast.

Thanks,

Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Naomi — thanks for the clear recap. Helpful. Two quick items from my side:

1) Procurement: I'm looping in our procurement mailbox (procurement@novacare.com) and will share our standard procurement intake form. We typically need a headcount/budget approval and a vendor questionnaire completed before PO sign-off — that generally takes 4–6 weeks in our cycle.
2) Added security contact: Daniel (cc’d) will drive the SOC2 and audit-log sample requests.

One additional risk to flag from Legal: we have a preference for a single-vendor outbound firewall policy which can affect hosted deployments; can you confirm whether Redwood supports VPN/VPC peering or an on-prem option for pilot?

We're also attaching our internal priority matrix for context. I’ll confirm budget cadence by EOD 9/10.

Appreciate the structure — happy to take the pilot checklist once Marissa has a draft.

Best,
Sophie
